applicable_core_campaign_amendments.scope: Sample size rigor (exactly n=20 trials per browser per scenario, 280 planned core trials; pilot/exploratory data barred from claims)
Controlled DNS responder integrity (wildcard *.he.test., immediate Type 65 NODATA, fail-closed lock reload)
Browser DNS controls and metric isolation (disabled DoH/TRR, ephemeral profiles, DNS transaction metrics separated from TCP setup)
Specification of record integrity (draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 pinned reference)
Deterministic ordering and cryptographic provenance sidecars (Schema 1.1.0)

explicit_amendment_exclusions.scope: Live uniform netem qdisc delay parameter sweeps are excluded from the partner core campaign (retained only as historical Phase D analytical simulation)
The 200-probe live exact binomial acceptance batch is excluded from the partner core campaign (Scenario S5 core replication executes 20 live trials with a 50-probe testbed readiness preflight)

required_scenarios.description: Dual-stack healthy baseline (20ms total RTT, 10ms per link)
Symmetric link delay (150ms RTT, 75ms per link, IPv4 20ms RTT)
Asymmetric link delay (IPv6 600ms RTT, IPv4 20ms RTT)
50% stochastic IPv6 SYN loss (exact binomial acceptance)
Delayed AAAA DNS resolution (500ms delay on AAAA)
